pages.summary: Maya picked reading, saying she used to read a lot and now just scrolls. She replied around midnight and late evening in short, casual messages (with some "lol"). She named "Normal People", lent by a friend about a year ago, as the book she wants to read, and said before bed is when she'd read. She said she goes to bed around 1-2 and said "yes pls" to quiet hours. Her answer on pages per night is still unclear.

She sounded tired but willing, with short casual replies.
